_comment: House ads for the owner's own books. Add another object to 'books' to show a second book; the block renders every entry in order. Only use details from the real Amazon listing. Put the plain Amazon URL in 'url'; These are the owner's own books, so build_site.py links them to the plain amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> URL with NO Associates tag. Set "hidden": true on a book to keep its data but not show it. An entry with "coming_soon": true renders a teaser card (no link, no cover) with a button to the newsletter signup. Optional "pages" picks where a book shows: ["home"] (Hobonichi side, the default when missing) or ["dotgrid"] (the dot grid journaling page). Leave out "cover" when no verified cover image is available; the card then shows a plain title tile. "blurb" is optional. Optional "inside" is a short list of highlights shown under the details. To add a cover later, set "cover" (e.g. "assets/books/<ASIN>.jpg") and "cover_alt"; nothing else needs to change.
